name: Voxel-based 3D Fire Simulation
definition: A simulation using a 3D voxelized grid to hold attributes: velocity, smoke density, temperature, and fuel level.
summary: Voxel-based 3D Fire Simulation solves Navier-Stokes equations on a 3D grid, distinguishing itself by explicitly coupling temperature-driven buoyancy and vorticity confinement to restore realistic curling smoke dynamics.
